_notice: REAL, THIRD-PARTY-ONLY posts. As of 2026-09-02 this mixes two sourcing methods: (1) posts found via a connected social listening API (X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit) queried on demand — these carry real, API-returned engagement numbers (metricsAvailable: true, likes/comments/shares and, where the platform exposes it, views/engagementRate); (2) earlier posts found via public web search before that connector was available, which carry no engagement numbers (metricsAvailable: false) rather than a guess. Mintoak's own official channels (its website, and its own LinkedIn/X/Instagram/Facebook/YouTube posts) are deliberately excluded — the team already knows what it publishes itself; this feed is for outside listening. Dates are the post's actual publish date, stated directly by the source or the API (dateConfidence: "exact") — including dates decoded from a LinkedIn/X Snowflake-style post ID's own embedded timestamp — or a well-reasoned estimate anchored to the news event the post is visibly reacting to when no better signal was available (dateConfidence: "estimated", shown in the UI with a "~"). Neither is a crawl/discovery date. This is an on-demand query, not continuous real-time monitoring, and Instagram/Facebook/TikTok searches return discovery results rather than full post content, so those platforms are still thin here.

posts.postText: Episode 295 | The anti-disruption fintech pioneer | Raman Khanduja @ Mintoak — third-party podcast interview.
Pioneers Behind Mintoak | Raman Khanduja | Rama Tadepalli | Sanjay Nazareth | Founder Thesis — third-party podcast interview with all three co-founders.
MintOak CEO Raman Khanduja on How Digital Payments Are Empowering SMEs in India — third-party interview video (same date as the Analytics Insight podcast episode, likely the same interview).
Mintoak acquires Digiledge to enhance digital payments — third-party startup-news page post.
"So Mintoak just acquired Digiledge. This is why..." — personal post from Marlyn Jose, one of Mintoak's Africa-expansion leadership hires, on the Digiledge acquisition.
Mintoak Acquires Digiledge for CBDC and Bill Payments — third-party creator post covering the acquisition.
"Merchant SaaS platform Mintoak is set to raise Rs 80 crore in debt from BlackSoil" — third-party business-media Facebook post.

"Mumbai-based fintech Mintoak has acquired Dubai-headquartered ICC Loyalty, adding loyalty and rewards technology to its banking platform..." — YourStory's own Facebook post sharing its ICC Loyalty coverage.

Post by Jajabor Brand Consultancy — Mintoak's PR agency of record for corporate communications (Jajabor led PR for Mintoak's ICC Loyalty acquisition announcement) — tagged #fintech #corporatecommunications. User-submitted link; exact post text isn't independently checkable here (LinkedIn is blocked for automated fetch in this environment), so only the confirmed metadata is recorded.
"Mintoak Raises $6M in Series A Funding from PayPal..." — third-party business-media LinkedIn post on the Series A extension.
"Mintoak Acquires ICC Loyalty To Expand Fintech Footprint In Emerging Markets" — CNBC-TV18's own explainer segment on the acquisition.
"Mintoak Acquires ICC Loyalty | Raman Khanduja on CNBC-TV18 Startup Street" — CEO interview segment on the acquisition.
"Conviction to Scale: Mintoak's Acquisition of ICC Loyalty" — posted by Pravega Ventures, one of Mintoak's investors, discussing the deal.
"Fintech is moving beyond payments — and Mintoak is betting on loyalty... Raman Khanduja, Co-founder & CEO, Mintoak, speaks to @Arundathi_Ram. Watch the full interaction!"
"#BlackSoil provides ₹80 crore acquisition financing to Mintoak for ICC Loyalty deal"

Arabic-language coverage of the ICC Loyalty acquisition: "Mintoak Indian company acquires ICC Loyalty (UAE) to strengthen banking engagement and loyalty programs in the Middle East and Africa..." (translated) — the first genuinely Arabic-language post found; earlier Arabic-press search only turned up entARABI's English edition.

"KENYA'S FINTECH LANDSCAPE JUST GOT A MAJOR BOOST: Mumbai-based Mintoak has acquired Dubai-based ICC Loyalty in a cash-funded deal and Absa Bank Kenya is already a partner... Kenya is not on the sidelines, it's at the centre of a global shift in banking engagement."
"Mintoak acquires loyalty and rewards tech company ICC Loyalty"

"Mumbai-based Mintoak has acquired Dubai-based ICC Loyalty. Mintoak which powers merchant QR codes deployed by banks, is now entering into the loyalty and issuing business through this acquisition. Backed by PayPal Ventures, Z3Partners, Pravega Ventures Mintoak has raised around $30mn and supports over $93bn in annual TPV." — independent fintech journalist.

German-language coverage of the Visa-Mintoak partnership: "Visa has partnered with Mintoak to enable Asia-Pacific acquirers to transition from pure payment processing to platform-based models." (translated) — the first genuinely German-language post found in this dataset.

"Parag Rao, while serving in @HDFC_Bank as KMP invested in a startup Mintoak (payment aggregator) in his wife's name in 2018 n now HDFC Bank is one of the investors in this venture. Btw this startup is now into significant business relationship with the Bank also." @RBI @RBIsays — a critical/governance-scrutiny post, included for a complete listening picture rather than only positive coverage; not independently verified beyond the post's own claims.

"Day 2 of #MSMESparks2026 turns the spotlight on a question every growing MSME faces: how do you fund the next phase of growth? Join Eklavya Gupta (@recur_club), Raman Khanduja (Mintoak), and Tarun Singh (Highbrow Securities)..." — event-promo post for a panel featuring Mintoak's CEO; a different angle (conference speaking) than the ICC Loyalty coverage.

"#EXCLUSIVE: Mintoak plans to acquire Dubai-based ICC Loyalty. Recently, the company raised Rs 53.3 Cr (around $6 Mn) in its ongoing Series A. Valuation - Rs 2500 Cr. FY25 Rev - Rs 92.85 Cr (27.9% up), Profit - Rs 35.58 Cr (56% up)" — Entrackr journalist's own early-scoop tweet, five months before the official Aug 2026 announcement.

"#Exclusive: Mintoak to raise fresh funding at Rs 2,500 Cr valuation. As per @TheKredible, Mintoak has raised over $30 Mn to date. Post allotment, PayPal Ventures will hold a 9.02% stake in Mintoak" — social companion to the Dec 2025 Entrackr funding scoop already in Live Mentions.

"You can tell when a room believes in what's coming next. Last week in Dubai... Bringing together the ICC Loyalty (Official) and Mintoak teams, along with many of our banking partners, wasn't just about marking a milestone." — a personal post from Mintoak's own Head of Marketing (not the company's official channel), similar in kind to other Mintoak-leadership personal posts already included in this feed.

"When Visa starts exploring deeper investment in Bangladesh, global investors should pay attention... Visa recently partnered with Mintoak to help financial institutions across Asia Pacific move beyond payment acceptance into merchant SaaS, reporting, engagement and integrated banking solutions." — a Bangladesh-based commentator (PriyoShop) citing the real Visa-Mintoak partnership as evidence in a regional investment-climate analysis; the first Bangladesh-specific social mention found.

"We are pleased to have advised PayPal Ventures-backed Mintoak on its structured acquisition financing from BlackSoil Capital for the acquisition of Dubai-based Innovative Consumer Concepts (ICC Loyalty). The mandate involved advising Mintoak on the structuring and implementation of the financing through the issuance of non-convertible debentures (NCDs)." — the deal's law firm, on its own advisory role.

"In 2017, Raman Khanduja was at Visa. Amit Rai Narang was at RBS. Both walked away — Raman to build the merchant side of payments, Amit to build the consumer engagement side. Years later, Mintoak acquired ICC Loyalty... what convinced Vinay Menon to back Mintoak before any of today's numbers existed." — investor's own founder-story post ahead of a longer piece.

"Are payment companies really deciding what you buy next? Mintoak has acquired Dubai based ICC Loyalty, adding rewards and customer engagement capabilities to its bank led merchant platform... The acquisition also gives Mintoak a stronger foundation for expansion across West Asia and Africa." — independent commentator's analysis post.

"Last week, I was reading about Mintoak's acquisition of ICC Loyalty and it got me thinking... From: How do we get customers to transact? To: How do we stay relevant after the transaction?" — independent commentator's reaction post.

"For most of my life the story ran one way. Foreign company buys Indian company... Mintoak, a Mumbai fintech, just raised 80 crore rupees in debt to help buy a company in Dubai... An Indian fintech is now the parent. A Gulf company is now the subsidiary." — independent commentator framing the deal as a reverse-acquisition narrative.

"Loyalty Loop News™ — Mintoak Acquires Dubai-Based ICC Loyalty, Turning Bank Payment Infrastructure Into a Loyalty Engine Across the Middle East... What makes this acquisition important for the MENA loyalty landscape is the ambition behind it." — global loyalty-industry newsletter's own analysis.
